extreme.usageZh: 形容词：极端的 extreme sports。副词 extremely。名词 extreme。

examples.sentence: The wind is extreme today.
examples.trans: 今天风很极端。

examples.sentence: Extreme sports need more than a camera.
examples.trans: 极限运动需要的不只是相机。

examples.sentence: An extreme drop still has a rope with a name.
examples.trans: 极端的下落仍有一根有名字的绳子。

examples.sentence: They sold extreme joy and skipped the clinic.
examples.trans: 他们出售极端欢乐，跳过了诊所。

examples.sentence: Extreme weather on the tower is not a personality test.
examples.trans: 塔上的极端天气不是性格测试。

examples.sentence: An extreme brand that cannot fund safety is only paint.
examples.trans: 资助不了安全的极限品牌只是油漆。

adventure.usageZh: 名词：冒险 an adventure。形容词 adventurous。

examples.sentence: The walk felt like an adventure.
examples.trans: 这次走路像冒险。

examples.sentence: Her first adventure was a wet cliff path.
examples.trans: 她的第一次冒险是湿漉漉的崖路。

examples.sentence: Adventure without a map still needs water.
examples.trans: 没有地图的冒险仍需要水。

examples.sentence: They packaged adventure as a weekend and a waiver.
examples.trans: 他们把冒险包装成周末和免责书。

examples.sentence: An adventure that cannot turn back is a trap.
examples.trans: 不能回头的冒险是陷阱。

examples.sentence: Public adventure on a screen can hide a private ambulance.
examples.trans: 屏幕上的公开冒险能藏起私下的救护车。

attract.usageZh: 动词：吸引 attract attention。形容词 attractive。名词 attraction。

examples.sentence: Bright lights attract moths.
examples.trans: 亮灯吸引飞蛾。

examples.sentence: The tower attracts visitors at dawn.
examples.trans: 塔在黎明吸引访客。

examples.sentence: A loud landing attracts a crowd, then a bill.
examples.trans: 响亮的落地吸引人群，然后是账单。

examples.sentence: They attract beginners with a smile and a thin cord.
examples.trans: 他们用微笑和细绳吸引新手。

examples.sentence: What attracts cameras may not attract a doctor.
examples.trans: 吸引相机的，未必吸引医生。

examples.sentence: To attract attention is easy; to keep a spine intact is work.
examples.trans: 吸引注意容易；保住脊椎完整是劳动。

unique.usageZh: 形容词：独特的 a unique path。副词 uniquely。名词 uniqueness。

examples.sentence: Each stone is unique.
examples.trans: 每块石头都独特。

examples.sentence: Her jump had a unique pause.
examples.trans: 她的跳跃有一段独特的停顿。

examples.sentence: A unique view still shares the same wind.
examples.trans: 独特的景色仍共享同一阵风。

examples.sentence: They sold a unique experience to thirty people at once.
examples.trans: 他们把独特体验一次卖给三十人。

examples.sentence: Unique branding cannot replace a unique spine.
examples.trans: 独特品牌替代不了独特的脊椎。

examples.sentence: Nothing unique survives a copied waiver.
examples.trans: 没有什么独特能在复制的免责书里活下来。

platform.usageZh: 名词：平台 a jump platform；a video platform。

examples.sentence: Stand still on the platform.
examples.trans: 在平台上站稳。

examples.sentence: The jump platform shook in the wind.
examples.trans: 跳跃平台在风里晃。

examples.sentence: A video platform filmed the jump and not the rope check.
examples.trans: 视频平台拍了跳，没拍查绳。

examples.sentence: They built a platform higher than the last ambulance reach.
examples.trans: 他们把平台建得比上一辆救护车够得着的更高。

examples.sentence: Leaving the platform is a skill, not a mood.
examples.trans: 离开平台是技能，不是心情。

examples.sentence: A platform that cannot hold a wheelchair is not open.
examples.trans: 托不住轮椅的平台并不开放。

tower.usageZh: 名词：塔 a radio/jump tower。动词 tower over。

examples.sentence: The tower is red.
examples.trans: 塔是红的。

examples.sentence: Wind talks louder on the tower.
examples.trans: 风在塔上说话更响。

examples.sentence: A tower over the river still needs a dry stair.
examples.trans: 河上的塔仍需要干燥楼梯。

examples.sentence: They painted the tower and delayed the cord.
examples.trans: 他们漆了塔，推迟了绳。

examples.sentence: The camera towered over the jumper's fear.
examples.trans: 相机高出跳跃者的恐惧。

examples.sentence: A towering brand can still have a short rope.
examples.trans: 高耸的品牌仍可以有一根短绳。

rebound.usageZh: 动词/名词：反弹 the cord rebounds；a rebound。

examples.sentence: The ball rebounded.
examples.trans: 球反弹了。

examples.sentence: The cord rebounded harder than the briefing said.
examples.trans: 绳子比简报说的反弹得更狠。

examples.sentence: A rebound can be joy or a snapped neck in one number.
examples.trans: 一次反弹可以是欢乐，也可以是一个数字里折断的脖子。

examples.sentence: They filmed the rebound and cut the grimace.
examples.trans: 他们拍了反弹，剪掉了鬼脸。

examples.sentence: After injury, the rebound into work was slower than the brand.
examples.trans: 受伤后，反弹回工作比品牌慢。

examples.sentence: A market that lives on rebounds will sell the second jump first.
examples.trans: 靠反弹活着的市场，会先卖掉第二次跳。

examples.sentence: Check the cord twice.
examples.trans: 把绳子查两遍。

examples.sentence: The cord looked thin in the photo and thinner in the hand.
examples.trans: 绳子在照片里细，在手里更细。

examples.sentence: A named cord is safer than a pretty one.
examples.trans: 有名字的绳子比漂亮的更安全。

examples.sentence: They reused a cord past its jumps.
examples.trans: 他们把绳子用过了跳跃次数。

examples.sentence: Cordless ads still depend on a cord you never see.
examples.trans: 无线广告仍依赖你看不见的绳。

examples.sentence: If the cord has no log, the jump is a rumour.
examples.trans: 如果绳子没有记录，跳跃就是谣言。

wingsuit.usageZh: 名词：翼装 a wingsuit flight。

examples.sentence: The wingsuit is bright.
examples.trans: 翼装很亮。

examples.sentence: A wingsuit needs more than courage.
examples.trans: 翼装需要的不只是勇气。

examples.sentence: He packed the wingsuit after checking wind, not likes.
examples.trans: 他在查过风而不是赞之后收起翼装。

examples.sentence: Wingsuit clips hide the hours of packing.
examples.trans: 翼装片段藏起打包的钟点。

examples.sentence: A rented wingsuit is still a spine's contract.
examples.trans: 租来的翼装仍是脊椎的合同。

examples.sentence: Wingsuit fame that cannot fund a reserve chute is costume.
examples.trans: 资助不了备用伞的翼装名声是戏服。

equipment.usageZh: 不可数名词：装备 safety equipment。

examples.sentence: Pack the equipment.
examples.trans: 把装备装好。

examples.sentence: Wet equipment is a quiet emergency.
examples.trans: 湿装备是安静的紧急情况。

examples.sentence: They rented equipment older than the waiver.
examples.trans: 他们租的装备比免责书还老。

examples.sentence: Cheap equipment looks fine until the rebound.
examples.trans: 便宜装备直到反弹看起来都还好。

examples.sentence: Equipment logs are less photogenic than jumps.
examples.trans: 装备日志没有跳跃上镜。

examples.sentence: A body is also equipment; it cannot be swapped at the desk.
examples.trans: 身体也是装备；它不能在柜台更换。

parachute.usageZh: 名词/动词：降落伞 a reserve parachute；parachute down。

examples.sentence: Pack the parachute slowly.
examples.trans: 慢慢打包降落伞。

examples.sentence: The parachute opened late over the river.
examples.trans: 降落伞在河上开晚了。

examples.sentence: A reserve parachute is not optional branding.
examples.trans: 备用伞不是可选品牌。

examples.sentence: They parachuted cameras in and medics later.
examples.trans: 他们先空投相机，稍后才空投医护。

examples.sentence: Parachute packing is the unfilmed sport.
examples.trans: 打包降落伞是没被拍摄的运动。

examples.sentence: If the parachute is a prop, the ground is still real.
examples.trans: 如果降落伞是道具，地面仍是真的。

professionally.usageZh: 副词：专业地 packed professionally。形容词 professional。

examples.sentence: The rope was packed professionally.
examples.trans: 绳子被专业地打包。

examples.sentence: She jumped professionally after ten unpaid drills.
examples.trans: 十次无偿训练后她专业地跳了。

examples.sentence: Professionally filmed does not mean professionally insured.
examples.trans: 专业拍摄不等于专业投保。

examples.sentence: They spoke professionally and reused the cord.
examples.trans: 他们说话专业，却重复使用绳子。

examples.sentence: A professionally empty clinic still counts.
examples.trans: 专业地空着的诊所仍算数。

examples.sentence: To fail professionally is still to fail a spine.
examples.trans: 专业地失败，仍是让脊椎失败。

starter.usageZh: 名词：新手 a starter jump；also 开胃菜。

examples.sentence: This jump is for starters.
examples.trans: 这一跳是给新手的。

examples.sentence: A starter still signs a long waiver.
examples.trans: 新手仍要签长免责书。

examples.sentence: Starter prices hid the extra equipment fee.
examples.trans: 新手价格藏起额外装备费。

examples.sentence: They filmed starters more than they trained them.
examples.trans: 他们拍新手多于训练他们。

examples.sentence: A starter who can say no is already advanced.
examples.trans: 能说不的新手已经算进阶。

examples.sentence: Starter courage is cheaper than starter safety.
examples.trans: 新手勇气比新手安全便宜。

unfortunately.usageZh: 副词：不幸地 unfortunately。形容词 unfortunate。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately, the wind rose.
examples.trans: 不幸的是，风变大了。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately the clinic was a photograph.
examples.trans: 不幸的是诊所是一张照片。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately, the waiver was longer than the briefing.
examples.trans: 不幸的是，免责书比简报长。

examples.sentence: They said unfortunately as if weather were the only actor.
examples.trans: 他们说不幸，好像天气是唯一演员。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately is often a budget word.
examples.trans: “不幸”常常是一个预算词。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately the champion still needed a bus home.
examples.trans: 不幸的是冠军仍需要一班回家的车。

safety.usageZh: 不可数名词：安全 safety first。形容词 safe。

examples.sentence: Safety first.
examples.trans: 安全第一。

examples.sentence: Check safety before the camera.
examples.trans: 在相机之前检查安全。

examples.sentence: Safety that lives in a slogan will die on the tower.
examples.trans: 活在口号里的安全会死在塔上。

examples.sentence: They cut safety to keep the rate cheap.
examples.trans: 他们削减安全来保持廉价费率。

examples.sentence: A safety officer without a veto is decoration.
examples.trans: 没有否决权的安全员是装饰。

examples.sentence: Safety is a timetable of checks, not a feeling.
examples.trans: 安全是一张检查时刻表，不是感觉。

rate.usageZh: 名词/动词：费率 / 评价 a high rate；rate the jump。

examples.sentence: The rate is too high.
examples.trans: 费率太高。

examples.sentence: They rated the jump five stars and the cord zero logs.
examples.trans: 他们给跳跃五星，给绳子零日志。

examples.sentence: Injury rates hide in small print.
examples.trans: 受伤率藏在小字里。

examples.sentence: A cheap rate often means a thinner cord.
examples.trans: 廉价费率常常意味着更细的绳。

examples.sentence: The heart rate after rebound is also data.
examples.trans: 反弹后的心率也是数据。

examples.sentence: If you only rate joy, you will not rate ambulances.
examples.trans: 如果你只评价欢乐，你就不会评价救护车。

separate.usageZh: 动词/形容词：分开 separate the cord from the bag；a separate fee。

examples.sentence: Separate the wet ropes.
examples.trans: 把湿绳子分开。

examples.sentence: Keep a separate log for each cord.
examples.trans: 每根绳子单独留日志。

examples.sentence: The fee is separate from the smile in the ad.
examples.trans: 费用与广告里的微笑是分开的。

examples.sentence: They separated beginners from the good equipment.
examples.trans: 他们把新手与好装备分开。

examples.sentence: A separate 'safety team' cannot separate wind from budget.
examples.trans: 单独的“安全组”无法把风从预算里分开。

examples.sentence: Separate the jump from the brand if the brand will not pay the clinic.
examples.trans: 如果品牌不肯付诊所，就把跳跃从品牌里分开。

challenge.usageZh: 名词/动词：挑战 a real challenge；challenge the rule。

examples.sentence: The wind is a challenge.
examples.trans: 风是一种挑战。

examples.sentence: She challenged the thin cord before signing.
examples.trans: 签字前她质疑了细绳。

examples.sentence: A camera challenge is not a body challenge.
examples.trans: 相机挑战不是身体挑战。

examples.sentence: They sold a 30-day challenge and skipped rest.
examples.trans: 他们出售30天挑战，跳过休息。

examples.sentence: The real challenge is saying no on the platform.
examples.trans: 真正的挑战是在平台上说不。

examples.sentence: Unchallenged waivers grow like weeds.
examples.trans: 未受质疑的免责书像草一样长。

passion.usageZh: 名词：热情 a passion for climbing。形容词 passionate。

examples.sentence: His passion is maps.
examples.trans: 他的热情是地图。

examples.sentence: Passion packed the bag at 4 a.m.
examples.trans: 热情在凌晨四点装好了包。

examples.sentence: A passion that cannot rest will snap like a cheap cord.
examples.trans: 不能休息的热情会像廉价绳子一样断。

examples.sentence: They hired passion and unpaid the hours.
examples.trans: 他们雇佣热情，不付加班。

examples.sentence: Passion on a poster is cheaper than a reserve chute.
examples.trans: 海报上的热情比备用伞便宜。

examples.sentence: Keep a passion that can hear a doctor's no.
examples.trans: 留住听得见医生说不的热情。

purpose.usageZh: 名词：目的 a clear purpose。形容词 purposeful。

examples.sentence: Name your purpose.
examples.trans: 说出你的目的。

examples.sentence: The purpose of the check is the spine, not the clip.
examples.trans: 检查的目的是脊椎，不是片段。

examples.sentence: A purpose that needs an audience is a brand.
examples.trans: 需要观众的目的是品牌。

examples.sentence: They jumped on purpose after the wind warning.
examples.trans: 风警之后他们仍故意跳了。

examples.sentence: Purpose without a way down is only a slogan.
examples.trans: 没有下去的路的目的只是口号。

examples.sentence: Ask whose purpose the rate serves.
examples.trans: 问费率服务于谁的目的。

focused.usageZh: 形容词：专注的 stay focused。动词 focus。名词 focus。

examples.sentence: Stay focused on the wind.
examples.trans: 专注于风。

examples.sentence: A focused jumper still asks about the cord log.
examples.trans: 专注的跳跃者仍会问绳子日志。

examples.sentence: They told her to stay focused and not to read the waiver.
examples.trans: 他们让她保持专注，不要读免责书。

examples.sentence: Focused cameras miss the unpacked reserve.
examples.trans: 专注的相机错过没打开的备用。

examples.sentence: Focus on the landing, not on the likes.
examples.trans: 专注落地，不是赞。

examples.sentence: A focused brand can still be unfocused about clinics.
examples.trans: 专注的品牌仍可能对诊所不专注。

complain.usageZh: 动词：抱怨 complain about。名词 complaint。

examples.sentence: Don't complain about the wind; check it.
examples.trans: 别抱怨风；去查它。

examples.sentence: She complained about the reused cord.
examples.trans: 她抱怨重复使用的绳子。

examples.sentence: They called safety questions complaining.
examples.trans: 他们把安全问题叫做抱怨。

examples.sentence: A complaint that names a log is a gift.
examples.trans: 点名日志的投诉是礼物。

examples.sentence: Champions who never complain may still need a court later.
examples.trans: 从不抱怨的冠军稍后仍可能需要法庭。

examples.sentence: If you cannot complain, the waiver already won.
examples.trans: 如果你不能抱怨，免责书已经赢了。

desire.usageZh: 名词/动词：渴望 a desire to fly；desire rest。

examples.sentence: His desire is a quiet landing.
examples.trans: 他的渴望是安静落地。

examples.sentence: She desired a second jump and a first inspection.
examples.trans: 她渴望第二次跳和第一次检查。

examples.sentence: Desire is not a substitute for a reserve chute.
examples.trans: 渴望不能替代备用伞。

examples.sentence: They fed desire with clips and starved the briefing.
examples.trans: 他们用片段喂养渴望，饿死简报。

examples.sentence: A desired photo can desire your knees.
examples.trans: 一张被渴望的照片可能渴望你的膝盖。

examples.sentence: Name the desire, then name the exit.
examples.trans: 说出渴望，再说出出口。

overcome.usageZh: 动词：克服 overcome fear。过去 overcame，过分 overcome。

examples.sentence: She overcame the first step.
examples.trans: 她克服了第一步。

examples.sentence: He overcame fear by naming the wind, not by shouting.
examples.trans: 他靠点名风而不是喊叫克服恐惧。

examples.sentence: They told starters to overcome doubt and skip the log.
examples.trans: 他们让新手克服疑虑并跳过日志。

examples.sentence: Overcoming a bruise is slower than overcoming a comment.
examples.trans: 克服瘀青比克服评论慢。

examples.sentence: A brand that helps you overcome 'no' is not a coach.
examples.trans: 帮你克服“不”的品牌不是教练。

examples.sentence: Some walls should not be overcome; they are cliffs.
examples.trans: 有些墙不该被克服；它们是悬崖。

significant.usageZh: 形容词：重大的 a significant risk。副词 significantly。名词 significance。

examples.sentence: The delay was significant.
examples.trans: 延误很严重。

examples.sentence: A significant crack in the platform stopped the line.
examples.trans: 平台上一条重大裂缝让队伍停了。

examples.sentence: They called the bruise insignificant and the clip significant.
examples.trans: 他们说瘀青无关紧要，片段很重大。

examples.sentence: Significant risk needs a significant clinic.
examples.trans: 重大风险需要重大的诊所。

examples.sentence: A significant champion still takes the bus.
examples.trans: 重大的冠军仍坐公交车。

examples.sentence: Insignificant print often holds the significant clause.
examples.trans: 无关紧要的印刷常常握着重大条款。

impact.usageZh: 名词/动词：影响 / 撞击 a hard impact；impact the knees。

examples.sentence: The impact shook his knees.
examples.trans: 撞击震了他的膝盖。

examples.sentence: A hard impact is not a highlight by default.
examples.trans: 猛烈撞击默认不是高光。

examples.sentence: The jump impacted the village's sleep.
examples.trans: 跳跃影响了村子的睡眠。

examples.sentence: They measured impact in views, not in spines.
examples.trans: 他们用浏览量而不是脊椎测量冲击。

examples.sentence: Environmental impact of a tower is also a sport story.
examples.trans: 一座塔的环境影响也是体育故事。

examples.sentence: If impact is only a thumbnail, the body still keeps the receipt.
examples.trans: 如果冲击只是缩略图，身体仍保留收据。

miserable.usageZh: 形容词：痛苦的 a miserable wait。名词 misery。副词 miserably。

examples.sentence: The wait felt miserable.
examples.trans: 等候让人难受。

examples.sentence: A miserable wind on the tower is information, not mood.
examples.trans: 塔上难受的风是信息，不是心情。

examples.sentence: He looked miserable after the rebound, then smiled for the lens.
examples.trans: 反弹后他看起来难受，然后对着镜头笑。

examples.sentence: They called the injured jumper miserable and not unpaid.
examples.trans: 他们说受伤的跳跃者难受，不说没被付足。

examples.sentence: Miserable weather cancelled the jump; the waiver still stood.
examples.trans: 难受的天气取消了跳跃；免责书仍在。

examples.sentence: Misery that cannot be filmed still counts.
examples.trans: 拍不到的痛苦仍算数。

court.usageZh: 名词：法庭 / 球场 take someone to court；a tennis court。

examples.sentence: The ball hit the court.
examples.trans: 球打在球场上。

examples.sentence: They took the thin cord to court.
examples.trans: 他们把细绳带上了法庭。

examples.sentence: A sports court and a law court can share one bruise.
examples.trans: 运动场和法庭可以共享一处瘀青。

examples.sentence: The company feared court more than wind.
examples.trans: 公司怕法庭甚于怕风。

examples.sentence: Court papers named the missing log.
examples.trans: 法庭文件点名了缺失的日志。

examples.sentence: If safety has no court, it is a hobby of the lucky.
examples.trans: 如果安全没有法庭，它就是幸运者的爱好。

insisted.usageZh: 动词 insist 的过去式：坚持 insist on doing。名词 insistence。

examples.sentence: She insisted on a second check.
examples.trans: 她坚持要第二次检查。

examples.sentence: He insisted that the wind was too hard.
examples.trans: 他坚持风太大了。

examples.sentence: They insisted on a smile after the bruise.
examples.trans: 瘀青之后他们坚持要一个笑。

examples.sentence: Insistence on a clip is not insistence on a spine.
examples.trans: 坚持要片段不是坚持要脊椎。

examples.sentence: The starter insisted on reading the waiver aloud.
examples.trans: 新手坚持大声读免责书。

examples.sentence: If nobody insisted, the reused cord would still be pretty.
examples.trans: 如果没人坚持，重复使用的绳子仍会漂亮。

attempted.usageZh: 动词 attempt 的过去式：尝试 attempt to do。名词 an attempt。

examples.sentence: She attempted the jump at dawn.
examples.trans: 她黎明尝试了跳跃。

examples.sentence: He attempted to turn back and was called weak.
examples.trans: 他试图回头，被说成软弱。

examples.sentence: An attempted landing on wet rock is a report, not a vibe.
examples.trans: 在湿岩石上尝试落地是报告，不是氛围。

examples.sentence: They attempted a record and skipped a meal.
examples.trans: 他们尝试纪录，跳过了一餐。

examples.sentence: Attempted heroism without a reserve is a brand problem.
examples.trans: 没有备用的英雄尝试是品牌问题。

examples.sentence: Every attempted jump needs an attempted no.
examples.trans: 每一次尝试跳跃，都需要一次尝试说不。

professional.usageZh: 形容词/名词：专业的 a professional jumper。副词 professionally。

examples.sentence: Ask a professional.
examples.trans: 问专业人士。

examples.sentence: A professional jumper still eats and sleeps.
examples.trans: 专业跳跃者仍要吃和睡。

examples.sentence: Professional photos hid unprofessional ropes.
examples.trans: 专业照片藏起了不专业的绳子。

examples.sentence: They wanted professional risk on amateur pay.
examples.trans: 他们想用业余薪水买专业风险。

examples.sentence: A professional no is still a no.
examples.trans: 专业的不仍是不。

examples.sentence: Professional sport that cannot fund clinics is theatre.
examples.trans: 资助不了诊所的专业运动是戏剧。

experienced.usageZh: 形容词：有经验的 an experienced guide。动词 experience。

examples.sentence: Follow the experienced guide.
examples.trans: 跟着有经验的向导。

examples.sentence: An experienced packer checked the parachute twice.
examples.trans: 有经验的打包员把伞查了两遍。

examples.sentence: Experienced is not the same as insured.
examples.trans: 有经验不等于已投保。

examples.sentence: They put inexperienced starters on experienced ads.
examples.trans: 他们把没经验的新手放进有经验的广告。

examples.sentence: Experienced knees still remember the first rebound.
examples.trans: 有经验的膝盖仍记得第一次反弹。

examples.sentence: An experienced silence on the platform can save a spine.
examples.trans: 平台上有经验的沉默能保住脊椎。

bounce.usageZh: 动词/名词：弹跳 bounce back；a bounce。

examples.sentence: The ball bounced twice.
examples.trans: 球弹了两下。

examples.sentence: The jumper bounced and bit the air.
examples.trans: 跳跃者弹起来，咬到了空气。

examples.sentence: A bounce back into work skipped the scan.
examples.trans: 弹回工作跳过了扫描。

examples.sentence: They sold bounce and not the pause after.
examples.trans: 他们出售弹跳，不出售后的停顿。

examples.sentence: Bouncy ads forget the court.
examples.trans: 有弹性的广告忘了法庭。

examples.sentence: If you cannot bounce, you can still refuse.
examples.trans: 如果你弹不起来，你仍可以拒绝。

champion.usageZh: 名词：冠军 a national champion。动词 champion a cause。

examples.sentence: She is the town champion.
examples.trans: 她是镇上的冠军。

examples.sentence: The champion still packed her own chute.
examples.trans: 冠军仍自己打包降落伞。

examples.sentence: They championed passion and unpaid the physio.
examples.trans: 他们拥护热情，不付理疗。

examples.sentence: A champion without a bus home is still a worker.
examples.trans: 没有回家公交车的冠军仍是劳动者。

examples.sentence: Championship lights went out; the bruise stayed.
examples.trans: 锦标赛的灯灭了；瘀青留下。

examples.sentence: Champion a logbook, not only a flag.
examples.trans: 拥护一本日志，而不只是一面旗。

attracted.usageZh: 动词 attract 的过去式/过分：被吸引 be attracted to。

examples.sentence: Moths were attracted to the lamp.
examples.trans: 飞蛾被灯吸引。

examples.sentence: He was attracted to the tower at dawn.
examples.trans: 他被黎明的塔吸引。

examples.sentence: Viewers were attracted to the rebound, not the briefing.
examples.trans: 观众被反弹吸引，不是简报。

examples.sentence: She was not attracted to a smile that skipped the cord.
examples.trans: 她不被跳过绳子的微笑吸引。

examples.sentence: What attracted the camera did not attract the medic.
examples.trans: 吸引相机的没有吸引医护。

examples.sentence: Being attracted to risk is not a consent form.
examples.trans: 被风险吸引不是同意书。

disabled.usageZh: 形容词：残疾的 / 停用的 disabled athletes；a disabled lift。动词 disable。

examples.sentence: The lift is disabled today.
examples.trans: 电梯今天停用。

examples.sentence: Disabled jumpers still met a stepped platform.
examples.trans: 残疾跳跃者仍遇到一级级的平台。

examples.sentence: They disabled the comment that named the cord.
examples.trans: 他们停用了点名绳子的评论。

examples.sentence: A disabled ramp is a closed sport.
examples.trans: 停用的坡道是关闭的运动。

examples.sentence: Disabled athletes were in the poster and not on the tower.
examples.trans: 残疾运动员在海报上，不在塔上。

examples.sentence: Access is safety equipment, not a side note.
examples.trans: 无障碍是安全装备，不是边注。

influences.usageZh: 名词 influence 的复数 / 动词：影响。形容词 influential。

examples.sentence: Wind influences the jump.
examples.trans: 风影响跳跃。

examples.sentence: Clips influence starters more than briefings.
examples.trans: 片段比简报更影响新手。

examples.sentence: Family influences kept her on the ground that day.
examples.trans: 家庭影响让她那天留在地面。

examples.sentence: They used champion influences to sell a thin cord.
examples.trans: 他们用冠军影响去卖细绳。

examples.sentence: An influence that cannot hear no is advertising.
examples.trans: 听不见不的影响是广告。

examples.sentence: Money influences which bruises become stories.
examples.trans: 钱影响哪些瘀青会变成故事。

attract attention.usageZh: 动词短语：吸引注意 attract attention。

examples.sentence: Bright ropes attract attention.
examples.trans: 亮绳吸引注意。

examples.sentence: The late parachute attracted attention, then a silence.
examples.trans: 晚开的伞吸引了注意，然后是沉默。

examples.sentence: They attract attention with a smile on a thin cord.
examples.trans: 他们用细绳上的微笑吸引注意。

examples.sentence: Attracting attention is cheaper than attracting a medic.
examples.trans: 吸引注意比吸引医护便宜。

examples.sentence: A bruise that cannot attract attention still hurts.
examples.trans: 不能吸引注意的瘀青仍会痛。

examples.sentence: If only clips attract attention, logs will starve.
examples.trans: 如果只有片段吸引注意，日志就会挨饿。

be attracted to.usageZh: 动词短语：被……吸引 be attracted to sb/sth。

examples.sentence: Moths are attracted to lamps.
examples.trans: 飞蛾被灯吸引。

examples.sentence: He is attracted to quiet landings.
examples.trans: 他被安静的落地吸引。

examples.sentence: Starters are attracted to clips, then to waivers.
examples.trans: 新手被片段吸引，然后被免责书吸引。

examples.sentence: She was not attracted to a rate that skipped safety.
examples.trans: 她不被跳过安全的费率吸引。

examples.sentence: Being attracted to height is not the same as being ready.
examples.trans: 被高度吸引不等于准备好。

examples.sentence: What you are attracted to at dawn may not love your knees.
examples.trans: 你黎明被吸引的，可能不爱你的膝盖。

introduced into.usageZh: 动词短语：被引入 be introduced into a place/sport。

examples.sentence: Bungee was introduced into the town.
examples.trans: 蹦极被引入这座镇。

examples.sentence: New cords were introduced into the loft.
examples.trans: 新绳子被引入阁楼。

examples.sentence: Cameras were introduced into the briefing and stole the hour.
examples.trans: 相机被引入简报，偷走了那一小时。

examples.sentence: The sport was introduced into schools without a clinic plan.
examples.trans: 这项运动被引入学校，没有诊所计划。

examples.sentence: Once fear is introduced into a joke, the platform gets louder.
examples.trans: 一旦恐惧被引入笑话，平台就更吵。

examples.sentence: What is introduced into a body in a rebound is not a brand.
examples.trans: 反弹里被引入身体的，不是品牌。

since then.usageZh: 时间状语：从那以后 since then。

examples.sentence: She has packed slowly since then.
examples.trans: 从那以后她打包得很慢。

examples.sentence: Since then the log has stayed on paper.
examples.trans: 从那以后日志留在纸上。

examples.sentence: The tower has been quieter since then.
examples.trans: 从那以后塔更安静了。

examples.sentence: Since then they have named the wind before the smile.
examples.trans: 从那以后他们在微笑之前点名风。

examples.sentence: He has not jumped since then, and that is also sport.
examples.trans: 从那以后他没跳，那也是运动。

examples.sentence: Since then the court papers have been part of the kit.
examples.trans: 从那以后法庭文件成了装备的一部分。

as soon as.usageZh: 连词：一……就 as soon as + 从句。

examples.sentence: Call as soon as you land.
examples.trans: 你一落地就打电话。

examples.sentence: As soon as the wind rose, they closed the platform.
examples.trans: 风一变大，他们就关了平台。

examples.sentence: As soon as the clip went live, the bruise was a rumour.
examples.trans: 片段一上线，瘀青就成了谣言。

examples.sentence: Pack the chute as soon as your hands are dry.
examples.trans: 手一干就打包伞。

examples.sentence: As soon as the rate dropped, the cord got thinner.
examples.trans: 费率一降，绳子就细了。

examples.sentence: As soon as someone said no, the brand called it fear.
examples.trans: 一有人说不，品牌就称之为恐惧。

The minute (that).usageZh: 连词：一……就 the minute (that) + 从句。

examples.sentence: The minute she landed, she checked the cord.
examples.trans: 她一落地就查绳。

examples.sentence: The minute the warning came, they packed.
examples.trans: 警告一来，他们就收了。

examples.sentence: The minute that the camera left, the smile dropped.
examples.trans: 相机一走，笑容就掉了。

examples.sentence: Call the minute your knees shake.
examples.trans: 膝盖一抖就打电话。

examples.sentence: The minute a starter asks about logs, listen.
examples.trans: 新手一问起日志，就听。

examples.sentence: The minute profit outruns the clinic, stop.
examples.trans: 利润一超过诊所，就停。

depend on.usageZh: 短语动词：依靠 depend on sb/sth。

examples.sentence: Landing depends on wind.
examples.trans: 落地依靠风。

examples.sentence: Starters depend on an honest briefing.
examples.trans: 新手依靠诚实的简报。

examples.sentence: The brand depends on a spine it does not own.
examples.trans: 品牌依靠一根它并不拥有的脊椎。

examples.sentence: Do not depend on a smile instead of a log.
examples.trans: 不要依靠微笑而不是日志。

examples.sentence: Disabled access depends on a ramp, not a poster.
examples.trans: 无障碍依靠坡道，不是海报。

examples.sentence: A jump that depends on luck depends on an ambulance.
examples.trans: 依靠运气的跳跃，依靠救护车。

named after.usageZh: 动词短语：以……命名 be named after sb/sth。

examples.sentence: The tower is named after a river.
examples.trans: 塔以一条河命名。

examples.sentence: The cord was named after a number, not a hero.
examples.trans: 绳子以一个数字命名，不是英雄。

examples.sentence: A jump named after a champion still needs a log.
examples.trans: 以冠军命名的跳跃仍需要日志。

examples.sentence: They named the fee after 'safety' and spent it on ads.
examples.trans: 他们把费用以“安全”命名，花在广告上。

examples.sentence: Being named after courage does not pack the chute.
examples.trans: 以勇气命名并不会打包降落伞。

examples.sentence: A court case named after a bruise is still a map.
examples.trans: 以瘀青命名的官司仍是地图。

fitted out.usageZh: 动词短语：装备 fitted out with equipment。

examples.sentence: The loft was fitted out with dry racks.
examples.trans: 阁楼配备了干架。

examples.sentence: The starter was fitted out with a smile and a thin cord.
examples.trans: 新手被装备了微笑和细绳。

examples.sentence: A platform fitted out for cameras may not be fitted out for ramps.
examples.trans: 为相机装备的平台可能没为坡道装备。

examples.sentence: They fitted out the ad and underfitted the clinic.
examples.trans: 他们装备了广告，少装备了诊所。

examples.sentence: Fitted out professionally still means someone packed.
examples.trans: 专业装备好仍意味着有人打包过。

examples.sentence: If the kit is fitted out for a thumbnail, refit it for a spine.
examples.trans: 如果装备是为缩略图配的，就为脊椎重新配。

separate from.usageZh: 动词/形容词短语：与……分开 separate from。

examples.sentence: Keep wet ropes separate from dry ones.
examples.trans: 把湿绳与干绳分开。

examples.sentence: The fee is separate from the advertised rate.
examples.trans: 费用与广告费率是分开的。

examples.sentence: She separated the jump from the brand.
examples.trans: 她把跳跃从品牌里分开。

examples.sentence: A clinic separate from the tower is still part of the sport.
examples.trans: 与塔分开的诊所仍是这项运动的一部分。

examples.sentence: Do not separate the rebound from the scan.
examples.trans: 不要把反弹和扫描分开。

examples.sentence: Safety separate from budget is a fairy tale.
examples.trans: 与预算分开的安全是童话。

keep on.usageZh: 短语动词：继续 keep on doing。

examples.sentence: Keep on checking the wind.
examples.trans: 继续查风。

examples.sentence: She kept on packing after the others filmed.
examples.trans: 别人拍摄之后她仍继续打包。

examples.sentence: They kept on jumping after the warning.
examples.trans: 警告之后他们仍继续跳。

examples.sentence: Keep on asking about the log.
examples.trans: 继续问起日志。

examples.sentence: A brand that keeps on smiling may keep on thinning the cord.
examples.trans: 一直微笑的品牌可能一直把绳子变细。

examples.sentence: Keep on is not the same as cannot stop.
examples.trans: 继续不等于停不下来。

fall in love with.usageZh: 动词短语：爱上 fall in love with sb/sth。

examples.sentence: She fell in love with quiet landings.
examples.trans: 她爱上了安静落地。

examples.sentence: He fell in love with the tower and not the waiver.
examples.trans: 他爱上了塔，不是免责书。

examples.sentence: Do not fall in love with a rate.
examples.trans: 不要爱上一种费率。

examples.sentence: Starters fall in love with clips first.
examples.trans: 新手先爱上片段。

examples.sentence: Falling in love with height still needs a way down.
examples.trans: 爱上高度仍需要下去的路。

examples.sentence: A town that falls in love with jumps must also love clinics.
examples.trans: 爱上跳跃的镇子也必须爱诊所。

give up.usageZh: 短语动词：放弃 give up sth/doing。

examples.sentence: Give up the jump if the wind rises.
examples.trans: 风变大就放弃这一跳。

examples.sentence: She gave up the record and kept her knees.
examples.trans: 她放弃了纪录，留下了膝盖。

examples.sentence: He would not give up the logbook.
examples.trans: 他不愿放弃日志。

examples.sentence: They told him not to give up, meaning not to read the waiver.
examples.trans: 他们让他别放弃，意思是别读免责书。

examples.sentence: Giving up a clip can be a championship.
examples.trans: 放弃一个片段可以是锦标赛。

examples.sentence: Give up the brand before you give up the spine.
examples.trans: 在放弃脊椎之前先放弃品牌。

no matter how.usageZh: 让步短语：无论多么 no matter how + adj/adv。

examples.sentence: No matter how high, check the cord.
examples.trans: 无论多高，都要查绳。

examples.sentence: No matter how unique the view, pack water.
examples.trans: 无论景色多独特，都带上水。

examples.sentence: No matter how professional the smile, read the log.
examples.trans: 无论微笑多专业，都读日志。

examples.sentence: No matter how cheap the rate, ask about the clinic.
examples.trans: 无论费率多便宜，都问诊所。

examples.sentence: No matter how loud the crowd, you can still say no.
examples.trans: 无论人群多吵，你仍可以说不。

examples.sentence: No matter how passionate the ad, wind still has a number.
examples.trans: 无论广告多热情，风仍有一个数字。

insist on.usageZh: 动词短语：坚持 insist on sth/doing。

examples.sentence: Insist on a second check.
examples.trans: 坚持第二次检查。

examples.sentence: She insisted on a dry stair.
examples.trans: 她坚持要干燥楼梯。

examples.sentence: He insisted on naming the wind in the briefing.
examples.trans: 他坚持在简报里点名风。

examples.sentence: Insist on a ramp if the poster shows one.
examples.trans: 如果海报上有坡道，就坚持要坡道。

examples.sentence: They insisted on a smile and not a scan.
examples.trans: 他们坚持要微笑而不是扫描。

examples.sentence: Insist on a no that the brand can hear.
examples.trans: 坚持品牌听得见的那个不。

make great efforts.usageZh: 动词短语：付出巨大努力 make great efforts (to do)。

examples.sentence: They made great efforts to dry the ropes.
examples.trans: 他们付出巨大努力把绳子弄干。

examples.sentence: She made great efforts to read the waiver.
examples.trans: 她付出巨大努力读免责书。

examples.sentence: Making great efforts on a clip is not the same as packing.
examples.trans: 在片段上付出巨大努力，不等于打包。

examples.sentence: He made great efforts to turn back.
examples.trans: 他付出巨大努力回头。

examples.sentence: The town made great efforts after the court case.
examples.trans: 官司之后镇子付出了巨大努力。

examples.sentence: Great efforts without a clinic are still a poster.
examples.trans: 没有诊所的巨大努力仍是海报。

play a significant role.usageZh: 动词短语：起重要作用 play a significant role in。

examples.sentence: Wind plays a significant role.
examples.trans: 风起重要作用。

examples.sentence: Logs play a significant role in a quiet landing.
examples.trans: 日志在安静落地里起重要作用。

examples.sentence: Disabled access plays a significant role in who can stand on the platform.
examples.trans: 无障碍在谁能站上平台这件事上起重要作用。

examples.sentence: The waiver plays a significant role in who pays.
examples.trans: 免责书在谁付钱这件事上起重要作用。

examples.sentence: A medic plays a significant role the clip will not show.
examples.trans: 医护起的作用，片段不会展示。

examples.sentence: Money plays a significant role in which bruises become legends.
examples.trans: 钱在哪些瘀青成为传奇这件事上起重要作用。

focus on.usageZh: 短语动词：专注于 focus on sth。

examples.sentence: Focus on the wind.
examples.trans: 专注于风。

examples.sentence: She focused on the log, not the lens.
examples.trans: 她专注于日志，不是镜头。

examples.sentence: Focus on the landing more than the rebound.
examples.trans: 专注落地多于反弹。

examples.sentence: They focused on passion and defocused the clinic.
examples.trans: 他们专注热情，对诊所失焦。

examples.sentence: Focus on who is missing from the platform.
examples.trans: 专注谁没在平台上。

examples.sentence: A sport that cannot focus on ramps is a closed club.
examples.trans: 不能专注坡道的运动是关闭的俱乐部。

day and night.usageZh: 时间短语：日日夜夜 day and night。

examples.sentence: The wind talked day and night.
examples.trans: 风日夜说话。

examples.sentence: They packed day and night before the festival.
examples.trans: 节目前他们日夜打包。

examples.sentence: The clinic light stayed on day and night after the rebound.
examples.trans: 反弹之后诊所的灯日夜亮着。

examples.sentence: A camera that runs day and night still misses the log.
examples.trans: 日夜运转的相机仍会错过日志。

examples.sentence: Desire that works day and night will snap.
examples.trans: 日夜工作的渴望会断。

examples.sentence: Day and night effort is not a substitute for a reserve chute.
examples.trans: 日夜努力不能替代备用伞。

attracted attention.usageZh: 动词短语：吸引了注意 attracted attention（attract 的过去）。

examples.sentence: The late opening attracted attention.
examples.trans: 晚开吸引了注意。

examples.sentence: A reused cord attracted attention in court.
examples.trans: 重复使用的绳子在法庭上吸引了注意。

examples.sentence: The missing ramp attracted attention after the poster went up.
examples.trans: 海报挂上后，缺失的坡道吸引了注意。

examples.sentence: His no attracted attention the brand did not want.
examples.trans: 他的“不”吸引了品牌不想要的注意。

examples.sentence: What attracted attention at dawn was the wind, not the smile.
examples.trans: 黎明吸引注意的是风，不是微笑。

examples.sentence: If only bruises attracted attention, logs would still starve.
examples.trans: 如果只有瘀青吸引注意，日志仍会挨饿。

grammar.title: 现在完成时
grammar.usage: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词，连接过去与现在。They have gone through a hard year。标志词 already/yet/just/ever/never/for/since。对比一般过去：有具体过去时间用过去时。高中：完成进行 have been doing；被动 have been done。
forms: for + 时段 / since + 起点
have/has been + 过去分词（被动）
notes: He has 不是 He have。
短暂动词不宜接 for：改用 been here。
yesterday 用过去时。
since 接起点，for 接时段。
疑问 Have you ever...？

examples.en: Mina has packed the tickets.
examples.cn: 丽娜已经洗了杯子。

examples.en: They have gone through a noisy month.
examples.cn: 他们经历了嘈杂的一个月。

examples.en: He has not slept yet.
examples.cn: 他还没睡。

examples.en: The family has lived here since March.
examples.cn: 这家人从三月起住在这里。

examples.en: Long waivers have been ignored in the report.
examples.cn: 无偿时数在报告里一直被忽略。

examples.en: She has been waiting for the morning jump since ten.
examples.cn: 她从十点起一直在等夜班车。

exercises.q: She ____ packed the tickets.
I ____ finished dinner.
They have ____ the door.
选择正确句子。
We have not eaten ____.
Tom ____ (have) lost his key.
After she has ____ (eat), she will rest.
I have ____ (just / arrive).
现在完成由 have/has + 过去分词构成。
He have gone 正确。
碗是空的。她已经洗了。→ She ____ the tickets.
否定：They have started. → They have not started ____.
After he ____ (finish), he will sleep.
改错：She have packed.
改错：He has go home.
They ____ through a hard month.
____ you ever waited for a morning jump?
She has already ____ the apology.

grammar.title: 现在完成时再探
grammar.usage: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词，强调过去动作与现在的联系。在 after / when / once / as soon as 时间从句里，完成体突出“先完成再主句”。After they have gained enough knowledge, many people stop。对比一般过去：after they gained 也可，但完成体更强调完成性。高中：after having done 分词结构；现在完成进行 have been doing。
forms: after / when / once / as soon as + 现在完成时, 主句
for + 时段 / since + 起点
after having + 过去分词（分词短语）
notes: 时间从句里用现在完成代替将来完成：After I have eaten, I will go。不用 after I will have 在口语里也常简化。
already 多用于肯定，yet 多用于否定/疑问。
短暂动词可完成但不宜接 for 一段时间：不要 He has arrived for two hours，改用 been here。
after having done 更书面。
现在完成与一般过去常成对考：有具体过去时间用过去时。
